meta.experiment: per-cell trust localization: residual map vs |speed error| map, post-processing variants
meta.device: cpu (predictions served from cache; zero model forwards)

sources.prediction: data\cache\w2\ensemble (5-member Transolver ensemble mean, deployed quality)

formulas.residual_map: diag = PhysicsChecker(Config().physics).diagnose(pred, case); r = sqrt(continuity^2 + momentum_x^2 + momentum_y^2). diagnose zeroes r inside the solid AND on the wall-ring (fluid cells adjacent to the solid, residuals.py ~326-348).
formulas.error_map: e = |pred.speed() - gt.speed()|; fluid mask m = gt.mask > 0.5 (same mask as evaluate_cases).
formulas.flowfield_construction: FlowField.from_array(mean, case.domain, mask=encode_case(case)[1], sdf=encode_case(case)[0]) -- mirrors MeanPredictor.predict.
formulas.V1_smoothing: mask-aware: gaussian_filter(x*m,sigma)/gaussian_filter(m,sigma), evaluated on fluid cells; sigma in [1, 2, 4] cells; BOTH r and e smoothed.
formulas.V2_patch: non-overlapping k x k patches, k in [4, 8, 16]; patch score/error = mean over fluid cells in patch; patches with fluid frac < 0.25 dropped; Spearman over patches per case; AUROC (Mann-Whitney, tie-aware midranks, same helper as run_selective_prediction.py) for patches with patch_e >= 90% quantile within the case, averaged over cases.
formulas.V3_dynp: r / (0.5*speed_pred^2 + eps), eps = 0.05 * fluid-mean(0.5*speed_pred^2) per case (stagnation guard); speed_pred (not GT) so the score stays deployment-computable.
formulas.V4_rank: Pearson of per-case rankdata(r), rankdata(e) -- mathematically identical to V0 Spearman; used as an implementation sanity identity.
formulas.pooled_pearson: streaming Pearson over all fluid cells (V2: all kept patches) of all cases.

meta.zero_residual_note: fraction of fluid (gt.mask) cells whose r is exactly 0 (wall-ring zeroing + geometry-mask mismatch); these enter the correlation as ties, as in the published control.

sanity_gate.note: published 0.22 was an OLD FNO checkpoint at n=15; this run is the deployed 5-member Transolver ensemble mean at n=200 -- a different value is expected and fine.
